coverage: Source CSS, including component alternatives; not computed geometry

rules.selector:
/* over a light first section (before the 40px scroll) the bar prints in ink */
.dshd.is-lt:not(.is-scr):not(.is-open):not(.is-sheet) .dshd-logo,.dshd.is-lt:not(.is-scr):not(.is-open):not(.is-sheet) .dshd-link,.dshd.is-lt:not(.is-scr):not(.is-open):not(.is-sheet) .dshd-cart,.dshd.is-lt:not(.is-scr):not(.is-open):not(.is-sheet) .dshd-burger

/* scrolled bar follows the ground: walnut glass over dark, paper glass over light */
.dshd.is-scr .dshd-bar,.dshd.is-open .dshd-bar,.dshd.is-sheet .dshd-bar

/* over a light first section (before the 40px scroll) the bar prints in ink */
.dshd.is-lt:not(.is-scr):not(.is-open):not(.is-sheet) .dshd-logo,.dshd.is-lt:not(.is-scr):not(.is-open):not(.is-sheet) .dshd-link,.dshd.is-lt:not(.is-scr):not(.is-open):not(.is-sheet) .dshd-cart,.dshd.is-lt:not(.is-scr):not(.is-open):not(.is-sheet) .dshd-burger

/* scrolled bar follows the ground: walnut glass over dark, paper glass over light */
.dshd.is-scr .dshd-bar,.dshd.is-open .dshd-bar,.dshd.is-sheet .dshd-bar

/* the plank on the centre line */
.dsld-plank

/* products drop onto the plank one by one */
.dsld-objs

/* the tag hanging above the plank */
.dsld-tag

/* exit: the cover parts along the plank line */
.dsld.is-exit

/* leaving: the cover rises from the bottom, the tag swings in from its hole */
.dspt-leave .dspt-cover

/* arrival: covered in the server HTML, the tag swings away and the cover lifts */
.dspt-enter .dspt-tag

/* the lifting edge throws a shadow on the section beneath, and that section comes out of the dark as it is uncovered */
.ds-rev.is-act>.ds-rev-in::before

/* diagonal cuts: the section hangs over its neighbour and is cut on a slope (clip-path, so the neighbour shows through) */
.ds-cut-t

/* the wall: walnut + a spotlight that follows the pointer */
.dsh-wall

/* plank: a slab — top face lies flat, front face hangs below it */
.dsh-plank

declarations.transition: transform .6s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),translate 1s cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.64,1) calc(var(--i)*90ms + 350ms),opacity .5s ease calc(var(--i)*90ms + 350ms)
